affected_boundaries: worktree overlay cleanup to peer blob publication

observed_behavior: Overlay pruning fails with PostgreSQL 23503 after a peer commits a shared-document blob reference.
expected_behavior: The caller refresh preserves peer references and cleans only its owned superseded overlay data.
causal_mechanism: A global orphan-delete snapshot misses an uncommitted peer reference; worktree-scoped writer ownership does not protect shared text rows.

anti_pattern.structural_description: Locally scoped publishers perform global shared-store cleanup without matching transactional ownership.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: Foreign-key validation observes a newly committed reference that the cleanup snapshot excluded.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: Shared document identity remains protected until all publisher references commit; pruning retains ownership of busy candidates.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: Use document upsert row locks, scoped candidate row locks with SKIP LOCKED, and deferred retry from retained unpublished generations.

applicability_conditions: Independently published objects reference a globally deduplicated row.
known_non_matches: An exclusively owned row with no independently published references.
confirmation_evidence: A deterministic real PostgreSQL peer-project CLI regression failed with git_blob_v1 FK23503 before repair and passed after repair.
